drivers.notes: The PDF's technical-data table has no separators between numbers; values were split in the table's column order (Zn, Re, fr, Cms, Qms, Qes, Qts, Rms, Mmd, Xmax, Sd, coil diameter, former, coil length, layers, Le, Bl, gap, magnet, mass, SPL, rated power, Vas) and checked: Qts = Qes x Qms / (Qes + Qms) and Vas from Cms and Sd both agree (calculated). Rms and moving mass could not be split with certainty and are left empty. Manual: impedance 2 x 1 ohm; box simulations are 'Simulation 2 Ohm (coils in series)', so the T/S are taken as coils in series. Rated power ('Nennbelastbarkeit') 2000 W. Xmax 14 mm ('maximale lineare Auslenkung'). Voice coil 72 mm, aluminium former, 8 layers, winding 54 mm. Manual dated 2011; current status UNVERIFIED. Cms 0,02 mm/N. Speaker mass 21.8 kg. Re printed 1,5 ohm for this model (re_ohm set to 1.5 below).
